messages:
maya: Heads-up — product wants a single GPU heatmap for Hosted + Dedicated in Console. They want SM occupancy, memory pressure, and queue depth in one view so SREs can compare headroom across pools. Can we agree on schema + sampling?

dmitri: +1 on a unified view, but need to be explicit about aggregation windows. SM occupancy is very noisy at 1s. I propose p50/p95 over 1m windows and a 5m rolling avg for the heatmap color.

anna: Agree on windows. Also we need to decide whether SM occupancy is "SMs in-use / SMs total" per GPU or "SMs with active warps" — the runtime emits both. Which is more actionable for routing?

leo: For routing and autoscale, "SMs in-use / SMs total" (util %) maps better to capacity. "Active warps" is lower-level and fluctuates a lot. Heatmap should show util%.

maya: Good call. So canonical field: sm_util_pct. Keep active_warps as a debug metric but out of the main panel.

sam: UX note: Console needs both per-pool aggregated tiles and host-level drilldowns. Per-pool should be weighted by GPU count and show median pod queue_depth, not just host max.

priya: Telemetry constraints: Hosted emits sampled per-request traces; Dedicated emits per-host telemetry from agent. We'll need a producer-side enrichment to normalize labels: pool_type=(hosted|dedicated), pool_id, host_id, gpu_id. Can we standardize those?

dmitri: Yes — runtime team can add pool_id label on export. But for Hosted we sample ~1/100 requests today. That sampling won't cut for precise queue_depth percentiles. We should derive queue_depth from per-host queue counters emitted every 10s instead of request sampling.

anna: So final metrics list: sm_util_pct (1m p50/p95, 5m avg), gpu_mem_used_mb (1m p90), mem_pressure_pct (eviction pressure signal), queue_depth (10s sample -> compute p50/p95 per window). Also add active_warps_raw as debug.

leo: For the heatmap bins: use 10% sm_util buckets and 5 bins for queue_depth (0,1-4,5-9,10-19,20+). Makes the visualization simpler.

sam: Can we add an annotation layer for routing policies? e.g., mark pools that have fallbacks enabled or are reserved for Dedicated customers. Helps product teams see routing config vs observed headroom.

maya: Yes, Console team will accept a boolean label routing_fallback_enabled and reserved_tier. Those should come from the control plane. Sam — will you add a small API to fetch routing flags per pool?

sam: I will. Expect a /api/internal/pools/{pool_id}/routing_flags endpoint (cached). Will add to the dashboard metadata.

priya: About cardinality — if we attach customer_id to all metrics for Dedicated, cardinality explodes. Proposal: emit customer_id only at aggregate (pool) level and not per-gpu. Dedicated per-host metrics keep pool_id + host_id but omit customer_id in high-cardinality streams.

maya: Makes sense. Product won't need customer_id in the heatmap. If SRE needs it we can provide a filter in drilldowns that queries traces with customer_id.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: runtime-metrics-agent v3.14 will ship pool_id label and 10s queue counters tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Canary in prod-1 for 2 hours then roll.

dmitri: After agent rollout, I'll add the aggregation job in metrics-pipeline (prometheus->bigtable job) to compute p50/p95 over sliding windows. Need owners: metrics-pipeline (dmitri) + console (sam) + runtime (anna) + telemetry (priya).

anna: Also a quick API contract: telemetry will publish sm_util_pct as a float 0-100 and mem_used_mb as int. Please don't change types mid-rollout.

sam: Dashboard mockups coming by EOD tomorrow. Will include pool tiles, host drilldown, and routing flags overlay.

maya: Timeline: agent deploy tomorrow, aggregation job + schema updates by end of week, console mock -> alpha next week. Any blockers?

priya: Need sign-off on sampling docs for Hosted team — I'll ping growth/legal for telemetry policy confirmation.

leo: No infra blockers from my side. Just one ask: include a short-lived metric for backlog spikes (queue_depth_spike boolean) computed by comparing 1m to 5m median; that will help alerting.

maya: Good idea. Add queue_depth_spike = 1 if p95(1m) > 2x median(5m). We'll use that for paged alerts only.

dmitri: I'll add an alert rule in the metrics repo but keep it disabled by default until alpha feedback.

maya: Thanks all — I'll collate this into a spec and drop it in #eng-platform-docs. If anyone disagrees with the fields/windows/buckets post here. :thumbsup:

anna: :thumbsup:

leo: :eyes:

sam: Will review the mock tomorrow.

priya: noted, will follow up on telemetry policy.

infra-bot: canary-report: runtime-metrics-agent v3.14 canary on prod-1 OK. CPU 2%, mem 40%, no errors.
